senses.gloss: वेश-वाट वेश-वाट, house and court, Daśak. in Chr. 192, 10.

वेश वेश, m.
 1. i. e. विश् + अ.
 1. Entrance.
 2. A house.
 3. A house of prostitutes, Man. 4, 84; Daśak. in Chr. 193, 13.
 II. also वेष वेष.
 1. Dress, apparel, Man. 4, 18, and 200 (ष्); Pañc. 129, 17 (ष्).
 2. Ornament, decoration.
 3. Disguise.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. οἶκος; Lat. vicus; Goth. veihs; A.S. wie.

वेशक वेशक, i. e. विश् + अक,
 I. adj. Who or what enters.
 II. m. A house.
 III. f. शिका, Entrance.

वेशन्त वेशन्त (vb. विश्), m.
 1. A small pond.
 2. Fire.

वेशिन् वेशिन्, i. e. वेश + इन्, adj. Assuming a particular dress or form.
 --Comp.

वेश्मन् वेश्मन्, i. e. विश् + मन्, n.
 1. A house, Pañc. iii. d. 172; 218; an abode.
 2. A temple, Rājat. 5, 167.
 --Comp.

वेष्ट् वेष्ट्, i. 1, Ātm. To surround, to encompass, to twist about, MBh. 1, 1800. वेष्टित,
 1. Dressed, Hit. pr. d. 40, M.M.
 2. Stopped, Hit. 106, 17.
 3. Secured from access.
 4. Enveloped, wrapped up, Man. 1, 49.
 --Caus.
 1. To surround, MBh. 12, 12449.
 2. To twist about, MBh. 1, 1801.
 3. To invest, to blockade, Ragh. 11, 51; 52 (Calc.).
 --With the prep. आ आ, To twist, Pañc. i. d. 376.
 --With उद् उद्, To untwist, Megh. 89; MBh. 7, 3168 उद्वेष्टन्ति is to be changed to उच्चेष्टन्ति.
 --Caus. To open, Mālav. 70, 17.
 --With उप उप, उपवेष्टित, Twined, Mṛcch. 115, 13.
 --With परि परि, To surround, Pañc. 97, 25. परि-वेष्टित,
 1. Tied, Hit. ii. d. 131.
 2. Covered, veiled.
 --Caus. To embrace, Pañc. i. d. 41.
 --With प्र प्र, प्र-वेष्टित, Covered, MBh. 3, 10047.
 --With सम् सम्, To surround one's self, to be surrounded, MBh. 12, 12449.
 --Caus.
 1. To surround, to encompass, MBh. 3, 10264.
 2. To cover, MBh. 3, 12889.

वेष्ट वेष्ट् + अ, m.
 1. Surrounding.
 2. An enclosure, a fence.
 3. A turban. []
 4. Resin.
 5. Turpentine.
 --Comp.

वेष्टक वेष्ट् + अक,
 I. adj. Surrounding, a surrounder.
 II. m.
 1. A wall, a fence.
 2. A pumpkin gourd.
 III. n.
 1. A turban.
 2. Resin.
 3. Turpentine.
 --Comp.

वेष्टन वेष्ट् + अन, n.
 1. Surrounding, being worn, Rājat. 5, 343 (see उल्लासन).
 2. An envelope, Pañc. 147, 2.
 3. A wall, a fence.
 4. A turban, a diadem, Ragh. 1, 42 (cf. Sch. Calc. 43).
 5. The outer ear, or the meatus auditorius and the concha.
 6. An attitude in dancing, a particular disposition of the hands, also a crossing of the feet.
 7. Bdellium.
 --Comp.

† वेस् वेस्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To go.
 2. To desire.
वेसवार वेसवार, m. A condiment, as pepper, spice.
वेश्मस्थूणा वेश्मस्थूणा, i. e. वेश्मन्-, f. the main post of a house.
